Canonical, origin, public GitHub main, GitHub Production, and the immutable Vercel host identify released application commit 16936574c3d5cb225b3efeb50fe19d9ad3b26b8a. Public pointer, manifest, content object, canonical and immutable routes, changed Maryland byte identities, ZIP lookup, research consumer flow, responsive browser layout, and browser console/request checks passed. The guarded retained-byte projection is 3,644,782,881, below the 8 GB project stop. Exact Vercel provider build-log duration and runtime-log rows were inaccessible and are not claimed. This receipt does not attest to the commit that contains it or any future deployment.
